description: CI job timings are only visible for the final PR head, hiding per-head job durations and code-vs-bookkeeping churn across review rounds.
goal: Add a read-only CLI script scripts/measure_ci_head_durations.py that accepts PR numbers (defaulting to a --prs flag supporting PR ranges such as 360-366) and uses GitHub CLI queries (with an injectable runner seam for hermetic tests) to collect per-head, per-job start/end durations, separate code-changing commits/heads from bookkeeping-only heads (ledger, calibration, review commits), correlate reviewer iteration waits where logs exist, and print a summary table of median and longest job durations per job and per head. Add hermetic unit tests in apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_measure_ci_head_durations.py using offline stubbed GitHub payloads for sample PRs covering per-head durations, code vs bookkeeping head separation, reviewer wait correlation, and median/max aggregation, passing uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Per-head, per-job CI duration measurements distinguish macOS leg cost from bookkeeping churn without running live CI.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/measure_ci_head_durations.py produces per-head, per-job durations for PRs #360 to #366 from GitHub only.
Output separates code heads from bookkeeping heads and shows reviewer wait per iteration where the flow log has it.

Code in scripts/measure_ci_head_durations.py and apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_measure_ci_head_durations.py has no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' and passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint.
